offload_state_dict: offload a PyTorch state dict to memory-mapped .dat files with an index.json manifest
load_offloaded_weight: load a memory-mapped weight tensor from disk back into a PyTorch tensor
build_offloaded_weights_loader: build an OffloadedWeightsLoader to lazily load weights from disk or safetensors files
extract_submodules_state_dict: extract a subset of state dict entries matching a list of submodule names
create_prefixed_dataset: create a PrefixedDataset to access mapping keys with a string prefix prepended
